live_claims.text: The paper proposes a meta-cognitive knowledge augmentation framework with Cognition-Guided Knowledge Expansion and Cognition-Driven Knowledge Calibration modules (Figure 2).
It reports a structural decay law linking higher answer accuracy to lower uncertainty across QA tasks and model families (Figure 1, Figure 7).

CDKC improves confidence calibration and aligns subjective certainty with objective correctness across evaluated datasets (Figure 5, Figure 6).
